Its reported tolerance ranges are:marine strain MBBTBC9 survives temperatures of 4–50 ◦C, 0.5–7% NaCl, pH 7–13, and heavy metals (up to 500 ppm)[3]. This is presented alongside the Himalayan glacier strain[4]MTCC 4822[5], which[6]grows at 4–45 ◦C and pH 3–14[7], illustrating the species' capacity for sustained growth across extreme niches ranging from marine sediments to glacier soils.[8][9]
